song.title: As We Worship You
song.lyrics:
[V1] . E B As we worship You, let all the world come and see . C#m A How the mercy we've received from You, can set them free . E B As we worship You, let all this joy that fills our hearts . C#m A Bring a hunger and a hope to those, who've strayed so far
[C1] . F#m E As we bow in adoration, and stand in reverent awe . A E B Show Your majesty and glory, let Your anointing fall . F#m E As we declare Your Name Lord Jesus, as the only Name who saves . A B C#m B May the pow'r of Your salvation, fill each heart we pray
[V2] . E B As we worship You, let all the nations hear our song . C#m A The song of Jesus and His blood, that proved His love for all . E B As we worship You, may all the lost and broken come . C#m A May they hear Your still small voice, call out their names each one
